reasoning_content:
The Tomcat instances on 18080, 18081, and 18082 are all responding correctly with the expected content, and Apache is properly routing to them. I'm testing a GetFeature request with the version parameter to ensure the database layer works end-to-end, and I want to verify the MapServer mapfile and S3 configuration are properly in place.

I'm also checking that the webapps.properties mapping and the config.apikey file are correctly configured, and confirming that the WMS layer tree includes the expected planwerk layers from the database.

action.command: echo "=== WFS GetFeature with version ==="; curl -s -m 60 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs52?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=xplan52:planwerk&maxFeatures=1" | head -c 600; echo; echo; echo "=== WMS layer tree sample ==="; curl -s -m 60 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" | grep -oE "<Name>[^<]{3,60}</Name>" | head -15
